channel.title: Profound Naturals
channel.description: Handcrafted botanical perfumes, pure essential oils, absolutes and natural soaps. Australian made.

item.title: Carrot Cake 50ml
item.description: A sweetly spiced opening of cinnamon bark and nutmeg sets the tone from the first breath, lingering through every stage of wear. Osmanthus and jasmine bring a velvety, gourmand softness to the heart while creamy benzoin, vanilla oleoresin and vanilla essential oil wrap everything in a rich, layered warmth. Sweet without being sugary, floral without being light - this is comfort in a bottle.

item.title: Velvet Forest 50ml
item.description: Mediterranean cypress opens with a cool, green freshness before Australian native blue cypress deepens the accord with smoke and ancient earth. Baltic amber brings a warm, honeyed resin to the heart while creamy amyris sandalwood softens the base. Ambrette lingers as a velvety, pear-kissed musk - making Velvet Forest as close to living woodland as a bottle can hold.

item.title: Jazz Lounge 50ml
item.description: A brooding, resinous accord where galbanum opens with wild green sharpness before davana weaves through the heart, bringing a boozy, fruity warmth with an animalic edge. Australian native blue cypress adds smoke and ancient wood, while labdanum and amber draw it to a dark, leathery close. Bold, sensual and completely unforgettable.

item.title: Floral Fantasy 50ml
item.description: A lush bouquet of living botanicals - neroli, ylang ylang and tuberose dancing over a soft musky base.

item.title: Pr-nfr 50ml
item.description: Inspired by the sacred embalming rooms of ancient Egypt, Pr-Nfr opens with an instant, clean forest freshness of black spruce before myrrh weaves a smoky, ceremonial earthiness into the heart - the same sacred resin used in ancient ritual and preservation. Warm Baltic amber and rich vanilla oleoresin settle into the base, drawing it to a deeply resinous, honeyed close. Simple in composition, profound in character - Pr-Nfr is a timeless, skin-warming fragrance that settles beautifully and lasts.

item.title: Pr-nfrt 50ml
item.description: A radiant floral amber and the feminine counterpart to Pr-nfr. Rose and jasmine bloom at the heart, lifted by a breath of green galbanum, while davana lends a soft, fruity warmth that turns uniquely with the skin. A base of Baltic amber and sandalwood grounds the bouquet in golden, lingering warmth. Named for beauty itself - luminous, sensual and quietly profound.

item.title: The Old World 50ml
item.description: Black spruce and galbanum open together, cool and green, a crisp breath of fresh forest air. Galbanum quickly takes the lead, sharp and resinous, with Baltic amber glowing warm behind it, while Virginian cedarwood threads a dry, woody calm through the heart. As the green slowly softens it settles into a deep amber hum, honeyed and low, lingering warm on the skin long after. Fresh at the first breath and profoundly grounded at the last, The Old World begins in the forest and ends in old resin. Available in 50ml and 10ml.

item.title: Sun-Kissed Lemonade 50ml
item.description: May chang opens bright and sherbet-sweet, all lemon candy and sunlit citrus, with davana lending a soft fruity warmth beneath. The heart barrels into osmanthus, ripe with apricot and stone fruit, while boronia, white champaca and tuberose bloom around it in a lush, honeyed bouquet. Vanilla oleoresin, tonka and benzoin draw it to a sweet, resinous close, with sandalwood lending a creamy calm underneath. Bright, fruity and unashamedly sweet from the first breath to the last. Available in 50ml and 10ml.

item.title: Hemp Soap - Lavender 115g
item.description: A gentle, conditioning soap bar crafted on a rich base of extra virgin olive oil, coconut oil and hemp seed oil. Lavandin Grosso - a bold, intense variety of lavender known for its lasting clean scent - fills every lather with a fresh, herbaceous calm. Sweet almond oil and castor oil add a creamy, skin-loving richness that soothes as it cleanses. Simple, pure and deeply satisfying.

item.title: Hemp Soap - Eucalyptus 115g
item.description: A deeply cleansing botanical soap bar built on a nourishing base of extra virgin olive oil, coconut oil and hemp seed oil. Two varieties of eucalyptus - the sharp, clarifying Kochii and the softer, more rounded Radiata - create a full-spectrum eucalyptus experience that awakens the senses and leaves skin feeling clean and refreshed. Enriched with apricot kernel oil, oat protein and Abyssinian oil for a gentle, conditioning lather that never strips.

item.title: Black Soap - Lavender, Boronia & Daisy 115g
item.description: Built on a base of authentic African black soap from Ghana - a traditional deep-cleansing formulation made with plantain skin ash, palm kernel oil and shea butter that has been used for centuries across West Africa for its extraordinary skin-purifying properties. Activated charcoal amplifies the cleanse, drawing out impurities while leaving skin balanced and refreshed. The botanical heart is a trio of rare florals - boronia absolute from the wild heathlands of Western Australia brings a rich, earthy complexity; lavender adds a clean, herbal calm; and daisy lends a soft, cheerful brightness that lifts the whole accord. Deeply cleansing, beautifully fragrant and genuinely botanical.

item.title: Black Soap - Woody Eucalyptus 115g
item.description: Crafted with authentic African black soap from Ghana, this bar pairs traditional deep-cleansing properties with activated charcoal and a grounding woody eucalyptus blend - purifying, earthy and forest-fresh.

item.title: Hemp Soap - Peppermint 115g
item.description: A refreshing, skin-loving soap bar built on a nourishing base of extra virgin olive oil, coconut oil and hemp seed oil. Peppermint essential oil delivers a powerful, long-lasting coolness that awakens the senses while golden jojoba and sweet almond oil leave skin soft and conditioned. Pure, simple and invigorating. ⚠️ Not recommended for use on sensitive areas - the cooling effect is powerful and long-lasting.

item.title: Aroma Necklaces
item.description: A hand-crafted diffuser necklace with a lava stone pendant - add a drop of your favourite essential oil and carry your scent all day.

item.title: Himalayan Cedarwood 10ml
item.description: A rich, balsamic cedarwood steam-distilled from the Himalayan region - deeper and more resinous than Virginian cedarwood, with a warm, woody sweetness. Prized in aromatherapy for its naturally grounding and calming character, it is traditionally used to quiet a busy mind, encourage restful relaxation and bring a sense of stability. Its warm, anchoring scent also makes it a natural fit for meditative and woody base-note blends.

item.title: Jasmine 10ml
item.description: One of nature's most prized florals - a rich, heady jasmine absolute with an intoxicating sweetness that lingers beautifully in a blend. Known as the queen of the night, for the hours after dark when the flowers open and the scent reaches its fullest. Jasmine is never distilled: heat destroys the balance, so it is solvent extracted instead, and this one is hexane free. A single drop transforms any blend with its deep, sensual floral richness.

item.title: Bergamot 10ml
item.description: A bright, citrusy-floral oil cold-pressed from Italian bergamot rind - uplifting, balancing and a classic in fine perfumery. Long valued in aromatherapy for its naturally mood-lifting and calming qualities, it is traditionally used to ease tension and encourage a sense of relaxed wellbeing, while its fresh, clarifying character also makes it a favourite in natural skincare blends. Radiant, fragrant and quietly restorative.

item.title: Eucalyptus Blue Gum 10ml
item.description: The classic Australian eucalyptus and the most recognisable of them all - sharp, camphorous and bracing. Steam-distilled from Eucalyptus globulus and rich in 1,8-cineole, the compound that gives the whole genus its unmistakable character. This is the benchmark, the one every other eucalypt gets measured against, and the long-standing choice for diffusing, steam inhalation and invigorating blends. Bold, fresh and instantly recognisable.

item.title: Eucalyptus Radiata 10ml
item.description: The eucalypt for anyone who finds Blue Gum too sharp. Steam-distilled from Eucalyptus radiata and naturally high in 1,8-cineole, it carries the same unmistakable eucalyptus character in a softer, sweeter, less camphorous form - crisp and clean rather than medicinal. It lifts a blend instead of dominating it, which is why it has such a long history in steam and inhalation traditions and why it is the one I keep closest to hand. Cineole-rich oils should not be applied on or near the face of children under 10.

item.title: Eucalyptus Kochii 10ml
item.description: A rare Western Australian eucalyptus carrying one of the highest natural 1,8-cineole contents of any species in the genus - exceptionally clean and beautifully pure. Steam-distilled from Eucalyptus kochii, it is the sharpest and most penetrating of the eucalypts. Where the others are rounded, this one is all edge, which makes a very little go a long way in a blend. Crisp, intense and unmistakably fresh.

item.title: Blue Tansy 10ml
item.description: A stunning deep blue oil steam-distilled from the flowering tops of Tanacetum annuum in Morocco. The colour is nowhere in the living plant - it forms in the still, as chamazulene develops during distillation, and can run to a third of the finished oil. Sweet, herbaceous and softly camphorous, with a depth that has made it one of the most sought-after blues in perfumery. Not to be confused with common tansy, which is a different plant entirely.

item.title: Tea Tree 10ml
item.description: Pure Australian tea tree oil - the most recognised essential oil this country has produced, and one of the most versatile you can own. Sharp, fresh and medicinal in character, steam-distilled from the leaves of Melaleuca alternifolia. Its international quality standard, ISO 4730, defines it by a single compound: terpinen-4-ol. Long valued by Indigenous Australians and a staple of the natural range ever since. A true essential in every collection.

item.title: Sandalwood 10ml
item.description: A deeply precious and sacred oil steam-distilled from the heartwood of Indian sandalwood - rich, creamy and woody with a warm, sweet softness that lingers beautifully in a blend for hours. Revered for centuries in meditation and ritual, it is treasured for its naturally grounding and calming qualities, traditionally used to still the mind, deepen breath and encourage inner peace. Equally prized in natural skincare for its softening, conditioning character.

item.title: Baltic Amber 10ml
item.description: An extraordinary oil extracted from genuine Baltic amber - fossilised tree resin between 40 and 70 million years old. Warm, earthy and resinous with subtle woody and smoky undertones. One of the rarest ingredients in botanical perfumery.

item.title: Honeysuckle 10ml
item.description: Sweet, honeyed and luminously floral - honeysuckle absolute captures the living warmth of the flower at its peak bloom. Rich and slightly green with a soft, nectar-like depth that lingers beautifully in a blend. Organic, hexane-free extraction.

item.title: Lemon 10ml
item.description: Bright, clean and unmistakably fresh. Cold-pressed from the peel of Citrus limon - sharp, zesty and instantly uplifting with a sparkling, slightly floral character that makes it one of the most versatile top notes in natural perfumery. Blends beautifully with florals, woods, and other citrus oils alike.

item.title: Cinnamon Bark 10ml
item.description: Warm, spiced and sweetly enveloping. Steam-distilled from the bark of Cinnamomum zeylanicum - deeply rich and aromatic with an immediate intensity that anchors and elevates any blend. A natural fixative used in compliant concentrations for leave-on formulations.

item.title: Black Spruce 10ml
item.description: Clean, crisp and deeply forested. Steam-distilled from the needles of Picea mariana - an instantly recognisable forest freshness with a resinous, slightly sweet depth. Grounding and invigorating in equal measure, it opens beautifully in both solo wear and complex botanical blends.

item.title: Blue Cypress 10ml
item.description: Ancient, smoky and deeply grounding. Steam-distilled from the heartwood of Callitris intratropica - an extraordinary Australian native of the tropical north, scattered in small stands through the woodlands of the Top End, the Kimberley and far north Queensland. Rich, blue-toned and unmistakably earthy with a warm, resinous depth unlike any other cypress in the world. One of the most sought-after Australian native botanicals in perfumery.

item.title: Boronia Absolute 10ml
item.description: One of the rarest and most prized botanicals in natural perfumery. Solvent-extracted from the flowers of Boronia megastigma - a small flowering shrub native to the southwestern tip of Western Australia. Extraordinarily complex - rich, earthy and deeply floral with fresh fruity-sweet and tea-like facets, soft cinnamon and tobacco nuances, and a warm woody-sweet undertone that lingers beautifully in perfumery. Frequently adulterated elsewhere - Profound Naturals sources genuine.

item.title: Galbanum 10ml
item.description: One of the oldest aromatic ingredients known to humanity - galbanum was burned as sacred incense in ancient Egypt and mentioned in the Old Testament. Steam-distilled from the gum resin of Ferula galbaniflua, it opens with a sharply green, almost electric freshness before settling into a deep, resinous, woody earthiness that is completely unlike anything else. Rare, potent and unforgettable - a single drop transforms any accord.

item.title: Clary Sage 10ml
item.description: Herbaceous, earthy and slightly musky with a warm, hay-like sweetness. Deeply relaxing and balancing - a classic in natural perfumery and aromatherapy alike. Steam-distilled from the flowering tops of Salvia sclarea.

item.title: Ginger 10ml
item.description: Warm, spicy and energising with a fresh, zesty edge. Steam-distilled from the rhizome of Zingiber officinale - grounding yet invigorating with a rich, peppery warmth. Long valued for its naturally warming and comforting qualities, ginger is traditionally used to ease tension, settle and soothe, and bring a sense of vitality and warmth. A wonderfully fortifying oil for grounding, spicy and stimulating blends.

item.title: Nerolina 10ml
item.description: Soft, floral and gently woody - often described as a bridge between neroli and tea tree. Steam-distilled from the leaves and twigs of Melaleuca quinquenervia, this Australian native has a calm, clean sweetness with far more depth than its softness suggests.

item.title: Pink Grapefruit 10ml
item.description: Bright, juicy and uplifting - the freshest citrus in the collection. Cold-pressed from the peel of Citrus paradisi, pink grapefruit is an instant mood-lifter with a clean, slightly tart sweetness. Renowned in aromatherapy for its naturally energising and refreshing qualities, it is traditionally used to revive the senses, lift low spirits and bring a feeling of brightness and clarity. A cheerful, revitalising oil that adds sparkle to any blend.

item.title: Clove Bud 10ml
item.description: Intensely warm, spicy and deeply aromatic. Steam-distilled from the unopened flower buds of Syzygium aromaticum - one of the most powerful botanicals in natural perfumery. Use with care; a little goes a very long way.

item.title: Rose Geranium 10ml
item.description: Lush, rosy and softly green - a more complex and earthy alternative to rose absolute. Steam-distilled from Pelargonium graveolens, rose geranium bridges the gap between florals and herbaceous with effortless elegance.

item.title: Lime Distilled 10ml
item.description: Crisp, clean and vibrantly citrusy - steam distillation gives this lime a brighter, more transparent character than cold-pressed. Refreshing and sharp with a subtle sweetness that lifts any accord. Valued for its naturally uplifting and refreshing qualities, lime is traditionally used to clear the mind, sharpen focus and dispel sluggishness, bringing a clean, energising zing. A bright, revitalising top note for fresh and cheerful blends.

item.title: Ho Wood 10ml
item.description: Soft, woody and quietly rosy with a clean, slightly camphoraceous freshness. Steam-distilled from the wood of Cinnamomum camphora - a sustainable, high-linalool alternative to rosewood. Grounding, calming and beautifully versatile.

item.title: Sweet Orange 10ml
item.description: Warm, round and effortlessly cheerful - the most universally loved citrus oil. Cold-pressed from the peel of Citrus sinensis with a rich, sweet fruitiness that blends seamlessly with almost anything. Beloved in aromatherapy for its naturally uplifting and comforting qualities, it is traditionally used to brighten mood, ease tension and bring a warm sense of cheer and calm to a room. A sunny, feel-good oil that makes any space feel welcoming.

item.title: Kunzea 10ml
item.description: Fresh, earthy and medicinal with a clean, slightly woody edge. Steam-distilled from Kunzea ambigua - an Australian native from the coastal heathlands of south-eastern Australia. A botanical gem with a grounding, clarifying character unique to this continent.

item.title: Scots Pine 10ml
item.description: Crisp, resinous and deeply forested. Steam-distilled from the needles of Pinus sylvestris - clean, sharp and invigorating with a warm, woody drydown that grounds and clarifies. Renowned for its naturally refreshing and air-purifying qualities, it is traditionally used to support clear, easy breathing and to revive and invigorate tired bodies and minds. A bracing, restorative oil that brings the clean energy of the forest to any blend.

item.title: Nutmeg 10ml
item.description: Warm, spicy and sweetly woody with a rich, slightly camphoraceous depth. Steam-distilled from Myristica fragrans - a classic perfumery spice note that adds complexity and warmth to any accord. Familiar yet sophisticated.

item.title: Ambrette Seed 10ml
item.description: Velvety, musky and softly pear-like - one of the finest natural musk alternatives available. Steam-distilled from the seeds of Abelmoschus moschatus, ambrette carries a warmth and sensuality that lingers beautifully in a blend. Rare and highly prized.

item.title: Cocoa 10ml
item.description: Rich, dark and indulgent - the unmistakable warmth of pure cacao. A certified organic cocoa absolute from Theobroma cacao, clean-extracted and free from synthetic processes. Deep, roasted and sweetly bittersweet - it anchors gourmand accords with extraordinary depth. Decadent and deeply comforting.

item.title: Agarwood (Indian Oud) 10ml
item.description: One of the most precious and revered aromatic materials on earth. Steam-distilled from the resin-saturated heartwood of Indian Aquilaria trees - dark, complex, woody and animalic with a smoky, balsamic depth that evolves continuously in a blend. A statement ingredient.

item.title: Ylang Ylang 1st 10ml
item.description: The first fraction of the distillation process - the most volatile, bright and intensely floral. Sharp, heady and euphoric with an almost narcotic sweetness. The boldest expression of ylang ylang, used sparingly in top notes for maximum floral impact.

item.title: Ylang Ylang 3rd 10ml
item.description: The third fraction - softer, rounder and more balsamic than the first. The sweetness is deeper and more creamy here, with a rubbery, slightly earthy warmth that makes it the most versatile fraction for heart note blending.

item.title: Ylang Ylang Complete 10ml
item.description: The unfractionated, full distillation of Cananga odorata - a complete expression of the flower from top to base. Balanced, rich and complex with bright floral top notes giving way to a creamy, balsamic depth. The most naturalistic representation of the living flower.

item.title: Cypress 10ml
item.description: Fresh, green and woody with a clean, resinous warmth. Steam-distilled from the needles and twigs of Cupressus sempervirens - a Mediterranean classic with a crisp, forest-like character that grounds and clarifies.

item.title: May Chang 10ml
item.description: Bright, lemony and intensely fresh with a clean, almost lemon hard candy-like sweetness that makes it instantly recognisable. Steam-distilled from the berries of Litsea cubeba - more complex and fruity-floral than a straight citrus oil, with a slightly spicy edge that keeps it interesting. A favourite in natural perfumery and botanical cleaning blends alike.

item.title: Euca Blue Mallee 10ml
item.description: An Australian native with a high 1,8-cineole content and powerfully clarifying character. Steam-distilled from Eucalyptus polybractea - sharper and more penetrating than Blue Gum, with a clean, medicinal intensity from the mallee scrublands of Victoria and New South Wales.

item.title: Geranium Bourbon 10ml
item.description: The finest expression of geranium - steam-distilled from Pelargonium x asperum grown on the island of Reunion. Rich, rosy and green with a complexity that far exceeds common geranium. A backbone ingredient in classical and natural perfumery alike.

item.title: Rosemary (Spanish) 10ml
item.description: Sharp, herbaceous and invigorating - steam-distilled from the flowering tops of Rosmarinus officinalis grown in Spain. Clean, clarifying and deeply familiar, Spanish rosemary has a particularly crisp, camphorous character with a resinous warmth that blends beautifully across a wide range of accords.

item.title: Euca Citriodora 10ml
item.description: An Australian native with a bright, lemon-fresh character quite unlike any other eucalyptus. Steam-distilled from Eucalyptus citriodora, it carries a clean citrusy lift with a distinctly airy, kerosene-like undertone characteristic of the species and beloved by those who know it. Widely used as a natural insect repellent - particularly effective against mosquitoes. Dries down soft and powdery with a lingering freshness.

item.title: Tonka 10ml
item.description: Warm, sweet and richly coumarinic - tonka absolute carries a distinctive vanilla-like sweetness with hints of almond, hay and tobacco. Deeply comforting and tenacious, it anchors sweet accords with an almost edible warmth that lingers beautifully in a blend. Organic, hexane-free extraction.

item.title: Tuberose 10ml
item.description: One of the most intensely floral botanicals in natural perfumery - rich, creamy and narcotic with a heady, waxy sweetness that deepens in a blend. Tuberose absolute is a statement ingredient; complex, bold and unforgettable at perfumery concentrations. Organic, hexane-free extraction.

item.title: Frangipani 10ml
item.description: Exotic, tropical and deeply floral - frangipani absolute carries the full warmth of the Plumeria flower with a creamy, slightly spiced sweetness. Evocative and sensual, it bridges florals and exotics with effortless grace. Organic, hexane-free extraction.

item.title: Osmanthus 10ml
item.description: Delicate, peachy and apricot-like with a distinctive dark cherry undertone that emerges in a blend and gives it a remarkable, almost jammy depth. Steam-distilled from the tiny flowers of Osmanthus fragrans - one of the most prized florals in Chinese perfumery. Subtle yet persistent with a soft, leathery finish that elevates any accord it touches. Organic, hexane-free extraction.

item.title: Magnolia (White Champaca) 10ml
item.description: Heady, luminous and intoxicatingly floral with a warm, tea-like creaminess that is entirely its own. White champaca - Michelia alba - is one of the most revered florals in Asian perfumery, prized for its rich intensity and extraordinary tenacity in a blend. Organic, hexane-free extraction.

item.title: Vanilla Oleoresin 10ml
item.description: Rich, creamy and deeply comforting - vanilla oleoresin is one of the most beloved base notes in natural perfumery. Solvent-extracted from Vanilla planifolia pods, it carries a warm, balsamic sweetness with subtle woody and floral undertones that develop slowly in a blend. A natural fixative that rounds, anchors and softens everything around it. Organic, hexane-free extraction.

item.title: Elemi 10ml
item.description: Bright, resinous and refreshingly complex - elemi opens with a sharp citrus-green freshness reminiscent of frankincense before drying down to a soft, woody balsamic depth with a hint of spice. Steam-distilled from the oleo-resin of Canarium luzonicum - a member of the Burseraceae family alongside myrrh and frankincense. One of the most versatile top-to-heart transitions in natural perfumery.

item.title: Benzoin 10ml
item.description: Warm, sweet and richly balsamic with a distinctive vanilla-like creaminess and a subtle incense depth. A resinoid produced from the bark resin of Styrax benzoin - one of the oldest aromatic materials used in perfumery, medicine and sacred ritual. Exceptionally tenacious as a base note and natural fixative, it rounds and softens accords with a powdery, resinous warmth that lingers long after other notes have faded.

item.title: Cade 10ml
item.description: Smoky, tarry and intensely leathery - cade is one of the most arresting base notes in natural perfumery. Dry-distilled from the wood and twigs of Juniperus oxycedrus, it carries a dark, phenolic smokiness with burnt wood, tobacco and leather facets and a subtle sweet undertone. Used sparingly, it adds extraordinary depth and an almost primal character to woody, leather and fougère compositions.

item.title: Peppermint 10ml
item.description: Clean, crisp and invigoratingly fresh, with a bright green mintiness and a cool lift nothing else quite matches. Steam-distilled from Mentha x piperita, a natural hybrid of watermint and spearmint, and the benchmark every other mint gets measured against. A versatile top note that clarifies a blend without overpowering it.

item.title: Lavandin Grosso 10ml
item.description: Bold, bright and deeply herbal with a clean, camphoraceous edge that sets it apart from true lavender. Lavandin Grosso is a naturally occurring hybrid of Lavandula angustifolia and Lavandula latifolia - larger in yield and more powerful in character than its parent species. Its scent opens with a sharp, fresh lavender clarity before softening to a warm, slightly woody herbaceous depth. A workhorse of natural perfumery and one of the most satisfying lavender materials available.

item.title: Virginian Cedarwood 10ml
item.description: Dry, pencil-shaving cedarwood with a clean, almost transparent woody warmth. Steam-distilled from Juniperus virginiana - lighter and crisper than Atlas cedarwood with a subtle sweetness and excellent tenacity. A grounding base note that adds structure without heaviness.

item.title: Mandarin 10ml
item.description: Sweet, soft and warmly citrusy - cold-pressed mandarin is the gentlest and most rounded of the citrus top notes. Rich with a slightly floral, almost honeyed depth that sets it apart from orange or lime. Uplifting and approachable. Note - phototoxic when applied to skin exposed to direct sunlight. A patch test is recommended.

item.title: Oakmoss 10ml
item.description: Dark, earthy and unmistakably wild - oakmoss is one of the most iconic base notes in classical perfumery. Steam-distilled from Evernia prunastri, it carries a deep, forest-floor earthiness with mossy, woody and slightly marine facets that ground and anchor any accord. Used in compliant concentrations - IFRA regulated for leave-on applications.

item.title: Myrrh 10ml
item.description: Ancient, smoky and deeply resinous - myrrh has been prized for thousands of years as a sacred aromatic, medicine and perfumery ingredient. Steam-distilled from the oleo-resin of Commiphora myrrha, it carries a warm, bittersweet earthiness with smoky, slightly medicinal facets and a rich, balsamic depth that evolves beautifully in a blend. One of the great base notes of natural perfumery.

item.title: Rosalina 10ml
item.description: Soft, floral and gently medicinal - rosalina is a lesser-known Australian native with a character that sits beautifully between lavender and tea tree. Steam-distilled from the leaves of Melaleuca ericifolia, it carries a sweet, slightly camphorous freshness with a calm, rounded warmth. A versatile mid note that blends effortlessly across floral, herbal and woody accords.

item.title: Davana 10ml
item.description: One of the most extraordinary and coveted ingredients in natural perfumery. Steam-distilled from the flowering tops of Artemisia pallens - a small aromatic herb native to southern India, harvested at the precise moment of peak bloom. Davana has a quality unlike almost any other oil - warm, fruity and richly complex with a boozy, dried-fruit sweetness layered over soft woody and slightly herbaceous undertones. What makes it truly exceptional is how it wears - in a blend, davana shifts and evolves differently on every person, taking on a uniquely individual character. Prized by perfumers worldwide and found in some of the most celebrated contemporary fragrances. Unmistakable, and almost impossible to substitute.

item.title: Damask Rose (Bulgarian) 10ml
item.description: The queen of perfumery botanicals. Solvent-extracted from the petals of Rosa damascena grown in Bulgaria's famed Valley of Roses - thousands of hand-picked blooms in every millilitre. Deep, honeyed and richly rosy with spicy-sweet and softly waxy facets and a warm, lingering drydown - the definitive rose of fine natural perfumery. Available in 10ml and 5ml.

item.title: Damask Rose (Bulgarian) 5ml
item.description: The queen of perfumery botanicals. Solvent-extracted from the petals of Rosa damascena grown in Bulgaria's famed Valley of Roses - thousands of hand-picked blooms in every millilitre. Deep, honeyed and richly rosy with spicy-sweet and softly waxy facets and a warm, lingering drydown - the definitive rose of fine natural perfumery. Available in 10ml and 5ml.

Galbanum quickly takes the lead, sharp and resinous, with Baltic amber glowing warm behind it, while Virginian cedarwood threads a dry, woody calm through the heart. Vanilla oleoresin, tonka and benzoin draw it to a sweet, resinous close, with sandalwood lending a creamy calm underneath. Bright, fruity and unashamedly sweet from the first breath to the last. Available in 50ml and 10ml.
